notes: Fresh 1536x1024 capture from Whole-product QA evidence run 41777820194 (attempt 1) at commit d900c11604efefaa56616230f0b0818c26df3911, which is main after the alpha.13 release preparation. The accepted alpha.12 record is superseded because its digest no longer describes what ships. Who looked: Claude Code opened the capture from the run's artifact at full size, checked it against the concept the ledger records, and accepted it. No person has looked at this capture. The maintainer, Zachary Brenner, instructed in advance that this release be cut without further questions and that the work be reviewed and approved by Claude Code; this record is written under that standing instruction, and says so rather than naming a person who did not look. What was checked: the counts strip and toolbar, the queue table, and the review panel read as three planes. The header states the privacy posture (Private, On this device). Proposed filenames stay date-first, with em-dashes for absent values, and the model's confidence is a right-aligned percentage beside its track in the panel. Ready, Needs review, Proposing a name, and Waiting differ by icon as well as color. Evidence is attributed under Date and Type, each value on its own line. No collisions, clipping, illegible copy, or ambiguous focus were seen, and the run's automated contrast assertions passed. What changed is this release's: the sidebar is gone, and Queue (8) and Completed (1) are tabs above the table beside the '1 needs review' and '3 ready' counts; help and settings moved to the header and Pause is labeled; the table's Confidence column is now a Check column that says 'All checks passed' or gives the reason for review, with the confidence itself in the panel; Rename all ready replaces Apply all ready; a progress line (Reading Q1 Financials.pdf, 0 of 4 done) stands where the alpha.12 frame showed the drop zone; and the panel now opens with 'What to check', so the reason for review is above the fold, which alpha.11 and alpha.12 left as a follow-up. Evidence is introduced as the model's reading in its own words rather than lines matched in the document, and its values are no longer quoted. One observation, not a defect: at this size Parties now sits below the fold under the pinned Approve bar and is reached by scrolling the panel, where alpha.12 showed it; the reason for review took that space. The sign-off is accepted only for the digest and screenshot hash above. Any later change to a non-QA release input invalidates it and requires a new capture and review.
